title: Lucia Caminos
wikitext:
{{Spoiler}} {{/infobox}} {{Quote|The only thing that matters is who you know and what you got. |Lucia Caminos{{Ref|type=rockstarweb |name=vi-characterquote |date=05/06/2025 |url=https://www.rockstargames.com/VI |ref=''Grand Theft Auto VI'' website}}}} '''Lucia Caminos''' is one of the two [[Protagonist|protagonists]], along with [[Jason Duval]], and a playable character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto VI]]''. Lucia has a son with Jason named [[Tomás]]. She is voiced by [[Manni L. Perez]]. ==History== ===Background=== {{Protagonists}} {{Quote|'''"Lucia’s father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk."'''
Life has been coming at her swinging ever since. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Sheer luck got her out. Lucia’s learned her lesson — only smart moves from here.

More than anything, Lucia wants the good life her mom has dreamed of since their days in Liberty City — but instead of half-baked fantasies, Lucia is prepared to take matters into her own hands.

'''A life with Jason could be her way out.'''
Fresh out of prison and ready to change the odds in her favor, Lucia’s committed to her plan — no matter what it takes.|[[GTA VI Website|''Grand Theft Auto VI'' website]]}} Lucia was born in [[Liberty City (HD Universe)|Liberty City]][https://gtavice.net GTA VI Love Magazine: New Details on Jason, Lucia, Raul, NPCs, Satire, and the Making of Leonida], GTAVice.net, October 2026. and was taught how to fight by her father from a young age. Since then, she has remained determined to improve her circumstances and provide the better life her mother always dreamed of. Around [[2024]], Lucia caught a thug—[[Jason Duval]]—trying to carjack her vehicle and struck him with a [[Baseball Bat|baseball bat]] that belonged to her mother. When police arrived on the scene to arrest them for public disturbance, the two teamed up, overpowered the officers, and fled in Lucia's car. After arriving at a motel, Lucia revealed to Jason that she had stolen the car for her mother, who was trying to become a real estate broker. From that moment on, the pair began dating and working together as partners in crime, with Lucia later giving birth to their son, [[Tomás]]. As they've been together for a while, Lucia left Jason for trying to protect her from going down the path of crime and took Tomás in as parental custody. ===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto VI''=== In [[2026]], in [[Little Cuba]], at the age of 26, Lucia took Tomás to a coffee shop (Rosita's Cuban Cafe) as her life started falling apart. As the waitress politely told Lucia to settle up under her boss' request, Lucia rediscovers her true calling and left Tomás behind, ensuring her that she'll return right away. Desperate for money, Lucia attempts to do a stick up at [[MoneyShift]], but her plan went wrong with a citizen that tried to hold her back. Lucia knocks him out cold and exits out of MoneyShift, trying fleeing from the police. Ultimately, Lucia failed to escape and was incarcerated at the [[Leonida Penitentiary]] after fighting for her family. After being released from prison, Lucia sees a life with Jason as a possible way out and is committed to changing the odds in her favor. ====Ending==== ''To Be Added...'' ==Description== ===Appearance=== Lucia is a Hispanic woman who is at least 26 years old. She has an athletic build, brown eyes, and long dark brown hair typically worn tied back or styled down. She wears small gold hoop earrings and has a subtle tattoo on her ankle. In her casual default appearance, Lucia wears a white tank top, tight light-blue jeans, leggings, shorts, white sneakers, and a gold chain necklace, though she is also seen early in the story wearing a prison jumpsuit and an ankle monitor following her release from [[Leonida Department of Corrections|prison]]. Throughout the game, players can freely customize her outfits, hairstyles, makeup, and accessories at shops across [[Leonida]]. ===Personality=== Lucia is ambitious, strong-willed, and fiercely determined to build a better life for herself and her family—particularly her mother and her son, [[Tomás]]. Shaped by a tough upbringing in [[Liberty City (HD Universe)|Liberty City]] where her father taught her how to fight from a young age, she refuses to back down from a challenge and carries a bold, no-nonsense attitude into every situation. Unlike [[Jason Duval|Jason]], who prefers keeping a low profile and taking a cautious approach, Lucia is proactive and willing to take high-stakes risks to get what she wants—leading [[Rockstar Games]] to describe her as the "engine" of their partnership to Jason's "brake." While she can be impulsive and ruthless toward anyone standing in her way, she remains deeply loyal and protective of those she loves. ===Skills and Attributes=== Like [[Jason Duval|Jason]], Lucia possesses the [[Focus in Grand Theft Auto VI|Focus]] special ability—a tactical mechanic combining slow-motion targeting with heightened environmental awareness to highlight threats, enemy weak points, and nearby valuables. Having been taught how to fight by her father from a young age, she is a capable street combatant and skilled driver who thrives in high-pressure chases and robberies. In hand-to-hand combat, Lucia utilizes an agile, martial arts-inspired fighting style incorporating fast strikes, kicks, and takedowns—contrasting with Jason's heavier, brute-force street-brawling approach. Players can further improve Lucia's core attributes—such as Stamina and Focus—through open-world activities like working out at the gym, hitting a punching bag, and completing safehouse routines. ==Influence== Lucia and [[Jason Duval]]'s criminal partnership across [[Leonida]] is heavily inspired by the real-life American outlaw duo {{WP|Bonnie and Clyde}}, with Bonnie Parker having previously served as an inspiration for [[Catalina]] in the [[3D Universe]] of the ''Grand Theft Auto'' series. Notably, ''Grand Theft Auto VI'' released on November 19, 2026—the same date as Bonnie and Clyde's first recorded bank robbery in 1932, further underscoring the comparison. In an interview with ''LOVE'' Magazine, [[Rockstar Games]] writer Alexa D'Agostino stated that Lucia was inspired by people she knew, including her own mother. She added that her mother raised her to be "rowdy, kind, but not to take any shit," which directly shaped Lucia's personality in the game. {{Clear}} ==Gallery== ===Trailer Screenshots=== {{H4|Trailer
